name: Hayman's Old Tom Gin
production: Victorian-style Old Tom family recipe with generous botanical quantities
history: 1863 | Hayman ancestor buys a gin rectifying business in Cale Street, Chelsea
expressions: Hayman's Royal Dock Gin | navy strength
serve_official: Old Tom & Sicilian lemonade with a lemon wedge (ideal serve); also Martinez, Tom Collins, Old Tom & lemon tonic
notes: Described as the longest-serving gin distilling family in England (five generations). Gin Guild pairs it with Jersey oysters.
